title: Erdoğan: Turkey Will Not Abandon Syria or Let Israel Set Red Lines in Region
detail: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan declared that Turkey will not abandon Syria and refuses to allow Israel to dictate 'red lines' in the region, staking out an assertive Turkish foreign policy posture. The statement underscores Turkey's continued engagement in Syrian affairs and its ongoing diplomatic confrontation with Israel following the Gaza conflict.

media.caption: Erdoğan declares Turkey will not abandon Syria or allow Israel to set regional red lines
